purpose: Formalize remaining V1 core/extension material sources whose licenses were previously only partially recorded, and separate generic dark-wood shape evidence from agarwood identity claims.

sources.author: Nicolas Eynaud
sources.use: blue-green feldspar color, white mottling/veining and surface texture reference
sources.notes: High-resolution mineral reference. Final workbench bead image may be generated/standardized from evidence; do not over-saturate into turquoise/neon cyan.

sources.source_site: Wikimedia Commons / Yale University Art Gallery
sources.author: Yale Digital Dura-Europos Archive
sources.use: real bead reference for deep-blue body color and natural surface/mineral variation
sources.notes: Final grade comparison should vary blue saturation, calcite white areas and pyrite distribution rather than simply darkening the bead.

sources.source_site: Wikimedia Commons / Yale University Art Gallery
sources.author: Yale Digital Dura-Europos Archive
sources.use: real bead reference for purple body color, translucency and natural variation
sources.notes: Final low/mid/high set should improve tone purity, uniformity and transparency without turning high grade unnaturally black-purple.

sources.source_site: Wikimedia Commons / The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.author: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
sources.notes: Obsidian workbench grouping is type-first. Do not force generic low/mid/high.

sources.author: Hwoarang17
sources.use: real bracelet source showing brown-gold tiger-eye bead language
sources.notes: Grade/effect comparison should be driven by chatoyant band sharpness, continuity, color contrast and polish.

sources.author: Daderot
sources.use: pink-lilac kunzite hue and transparency evidence
sources.notes: Mineral specimen rather than bead. Final standardized bead must preserve pale pink/lilac rather than artificial saturated magenta.

sources.use: upper-bound color/clarity evidence for high-quality display reference
sources.notes: Use only as evidence for the plausible upper range; final high grade should remain natural.

sources.author: Géry PARENT
sources.use: species color and natural matrix/texture evidence
sources.notes: Do not convert the natural purple/matrix character into a flat synthetic-purple bead.

sources.author: Deomar Pandan / KamayoJewelry.com
sources.use: real polished rose-quartz bead color and translucency reference
sources.notes: Low/mid/high should vary pink concentration, milkiness/translucency, uniformity and visible defects—not simply hue saturation.

sources.author: James St. John
sources.use: optional asterism reference for exceptional rose quartz
sources.notes: Star effect is optional/special, not the default high-grade Rose Quartz definition.

sources.zh_name: 深色木珠结构参考（非沉香鉴定）
sources.en_name: Generic Dark Wood Bead Shape Reference
sources.author: Daniel Tibi (Dti)
sources.use: generic wooden bead scale, polish and shape reference only
sources.notes: MUST NOT be labeled as agarwood. It cannot establish wood species. Crystal's dark wood / agarwood-like structural spacer may use generated project-original imagery informed by generic wood geometry, but the UI must not certify agarwood species without a species-specific evidence source.

remaining_species_specific_gap.gap: No sufficiently clear permissive agarwood-bead source has been verified yet.
remaining_species_specific_gap.safe_path: Use project-original/generated dark-wood structural-spacer display imagery and label it as dark wood / agarwood-like design material, not certified agarwood.
